title: Insight into the Binding Interaction between PEDCs and hERRgamma Utilizing Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: Bu, Fanqiang; Chen, Lin; Sun, Ying; Zhao, Bing; Wang, Ruige
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD研究酚类环境内分泌干扰物与核受体hERRgamma的结合，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象不匹配。
abstract: Phenolic environmental endocrine-disrupting chemicals (PEDCs) are persistent EDCs that are widely found in food packaging materials and environmental media and seriously threaten human health and ecological security. Human estrogen-related receptor gamma (hERRgamma) has been proposed as a mediator for the low-dose effects of many environmental PEDCs; however, the atomic-level descriptions of dynamical structural features and interactions of hERRgamma and PEDCs are still unclarified. Herein, how three PEDCs, 4-(1-methylpropyl)phenol (4-sec-butylphenol), 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-2-naphthol (tetrahydro-2-napthol), and 2,2-bis(4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl)propane (BP(2,2)(Me)), interact with hERRgamma to produce its estrogenic disruption effects was studied. Molecular docking and multiple molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were first conducted to distinguish the detailed interaction pattern of hERRgamma with PEDCs. These binding structures revealed that residues around Leu271, Leu309, Leu345, and Phe435 are important when binding with PEDCs. Furthermore, the binding energies of PEDCs with hERRgamma were also characterized using the molecular mechanics/Poisson Boltzmann surface area (MM-PBSA) and solvated interaction energy (SIE) methods, and the results showed that the interactions of CH-pi, pi-pi, and hydrogen bonds are the major contributors for hERRgamma binding to these three PEDCs. What is striking is that the methoxide groups of BP(2,2)(Me), as hydrophobic groups, can help to reduce the binding energy of PEDCs binding with hERRgamma. These results provide important guidance for further understanding the influence of PEDCs on human health problems.
abstract_zh: 酚类环境内分泌干扰化学物质（PEDCs）是持久性内分泌干扰物，广泛存在于食品包装材料及环境介质中，严重威胁人类健康与生态安全。人类雌激素相关受体γ（hERRgamma）已被提出作为许多环境PEDCs低剂量效应的介导者；然而，hERRgamma与PEDCs动态结构特征及相互作用的原子级描述仍不明确。本研究探讨了三种PEDCs，即4-(1-甲基丙基)苯酚（4-仲丁基苯酚）、5,6,7,8-四氢-2-萘酚（四氢-2-萘酚）和2,2-双(4-羟基-3,5-二甲氧基苯基)丙烷（BP(2,2)(Me)），如何与hERRgamma相互作用以产生其雌激素干扰效应。首先进行了分子对接和多次分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，以区分hERRgamma与PEDCs的详细相互作用模式。这些结合结构揭示，Leu271、Leu309、Leu345和Phe435周围的残基在与PEDCs结合时至关重要。此外，使用分子力学/泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM-PBSA）和溶剂化相互作用能（SIE）方法表征了PEDCs与hERRgamma的结合能，结果表明CH-π、π-π和氢键相互作用是hERRgamma与这三种PEDCs结合的主要贡献因素。值得注意的是，BP(2,2)(Me)的甲氧基作为疏水基团，有助于降低PEDCs与hERRgamma结合的结合能。这些结果为进一步理解PEDCs对人类健康问题的影响提供了重要指导。
